warmup.title: Stack warmup
warmup.subtitle: Bootstrap the platform's baseline knowledge into the stack-default story

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.headline: Let's warm up your AISHA stack
welcome.description: This wizard walks you through preparing the platform's baseline knowledge in the stack-default story. Everything you set up here is automatically inherited by every subsequent story via the existing per-story isolation + globals retrieval.
welcome.defaultPresent: Stack-default story is present and ready to receive knowledge.
welcome.defaultMissing: Stack-default story is missing — run the cold-start bootstrap first.

kb_upload.title: Upload knowledge
kb_upload.headline: Upload your initial knowledge sources
kb_upload.description: Upload and tag the documents, FAQs, expert rules, and other sources that should become the platform's baseline. These items will be retrieved as globals for every story.
kb_upload.requirement: Need at least {{min}} knowledge item to continue

rules_setup.title: Review profiles
rules_setup.headline: Review context profiles + expert rules
rules_setup.description: Context profiles determine which knowledge layers (KB retrieval, ruleset, graph context, learnings) get composed into the LLM prompt and in what order. Confirm the defaults make sense for your install.
rules_setup.body: Open the context profiles page to review or adjust the rulesets — or just acknowledge that the defaults are fine for the first pass. You can come back later.

test_query.title: Test a query
test_query.headline: Run a test chat against the default story
test_query.description: Verify that retrieval, citations, and the graph trail all flow end-to-end before you call the warmup done.
test_query.body: Open the stack-default story, ask a question about one of the items you uploaded, then verify the response shows up correctly with sources + graph context.
test_query.checkCitations: The citation panel under the answer lists the chunks AISHA used
test_query.checkGraph: The explainability panel shows the multi-hop graph trail to discovered concepts
test_query.checkRoute: The route plan (in admin AI runs) shows the chat hit the expected context profile

complete.title: Done
complete.headline: Warmup complete
complete.description: The platform's baseline is set. New stories will inherit it via compose_context kb_retrieval globals + graph_context layer.
complete.body: From this point on the wizard won't redirect you anymore. You can always return to this page to review the warmup audit history.
